description: This file defines a class DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy within the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Maintenance PurgeStrategy namespace. The class extends PurgeStrategy and implements a purge method that deletes records associated with an employee number, either as subordinate or supervisor.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging reports related to an employee, extending the PurgeStrategy class.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes entities related to the given employee number, both as subordinate and supervisor.
